technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with long-term bullish structure (50/200 EMA, Ichimoku) conflict with short-term bearish setup (death cross, price below key MAs, negative MACD); lacks momentum confirmation and trend strength for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: AON shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 2 days present elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear sentiment (22/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 small purchase vs 2 small sales) and absent news data provide minimal conviction support.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (435.2), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and earnings binary event in 2 days create compounded risk for AON.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term bullish structure (50/200 EMA bullish, Ichimoku above cloud) combined with extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9, Stoch K 10.39) and fear-zone contrarian sentiment (22/100) create asymmetric risk/reward for patient entry near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings event in 2 days, VIX crisis (435.2), macro headwinds (rising DXY, flat yield curve), short-term death cross, price below all key moving averages, negative MACD, and weak momentum confirmation make this a binary event with insufficient technical setup and unacceptable pre-earnings volatility risk.
